::: {#def-loyalty .theorem}
## Loyalty

We say a component function $g_{ti}$ is loyal to graph $\mathscr{G}$ if for $\mathbf{X}_t,\mathbf{X}'_t \in \{0,1\}^n$

$$
\begin{equation}
\mathbf{X}_{t\mathcal{N}_i} = \mathbf{X'}_{t\mathcal{N}_i}
\implies 
g_{ti}(\mathbf{X}_t) = g_{ti}( \mathbf{X'}_t) 
\end{equation}
$$

We say a structural equation is loyal to graph $\mathscr{G}$ if it is separable and all its component functions are loyal to $\mathscr{G}$. 

:::
